inputs.userGoal: Deploy a simple, low-cost VMSS Terraform execution plane in subscription 7abbc9d1-585e-452a-9f6d-a137a0015959 and attach it securely to the existing ZeroOps App Service control plane in another tenant.
subGoals: Keep all new billable execution resources in the empty Azure for Students subscription.
Use a scale-to-zero, single-instance demo profile with no instance public IPs or stored Service Bus credentials.
Accept only immutable, validated Terraform envelopes from the application; never execute arbitrary scripts.

reasoning.whyChosen: Separates execution-plane cost and blast radius from the existing App Services.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Cross-tenant identity federation is required for the existing backend to publish jobs.

resources.name: vnet-zeroops-exec-demo
resources.subtype: Dedicated VMSS virtual network and subnet

reasoning.whyChosen: Provides isolation for pull-only runner instances without inbound exposure.
reasoning.tradeoffs: The demo retains public PaaS endpoints protected by Entra RBAC to avoid Premium private-endpoint cost.

reasoning.whyChosen: Separates runner authority from the backend and survives VMSS instance replacement.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Uses several narrowly scoped role assignments rather than a broad Contributor role.

properties.publicNetworkAccess: Enabled for demo; Entra pull only

reasoning.whyChosen: Basic ACR is sufficient for one runner image and supports managed-identity pulls.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Private registry networking is deferred for the cost-focused demo.

reasoning.whyChosen: Standard supports session-enabled queues and queue-driven autoscaling at the lowest suitable tier.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Private endpoints and zone redundancy require Premium and are intentionally out of demo scope.

reasoning.whyChosen: Separates user artifacts from executor state while retaining low-cost LRS for a disposable demo.
reasoning.tradeoffs: ZRS and private endpoints are deferred to a production profile.

reasoning.whyChosen: Runs the existing hardened worker only when a queue has work, minimizing idle cost.
reasoning.tradeoffs: B-series CPU credits are adequate for low-volume demo work but not sustained parallel scans.

properties.targetRole: Azure Service Bus Data Sender on terraform-plan and terraform-apply queues

reasoning.whyChosen: Lets the existing backend obtain target-tenant Service Bus tokens without a client secret or SAS key.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Requires Entra app-registration permission in the source tenant and target-tenant service-principal provisioning.

references.title: Configure an application to trust a managed identity

overallReasoning.summary: A small execution plane in the empty subscription decouples runner cost from the App Service subscription while retaining managed identity, immutable image, and queue-based safety controls.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: For the demo, PaaS endpoints remain public but Entra-only, the runner has no inbound public IP, and private endpoints, zone redundancy, and Log Analytics are deferred to avoid baseline costs. Insights are empty by design.

plan.validation: Dependencies resolve, subnet ranges do not overlap, Service Bus Standard supports the required queues, storage has no shared keys, VMSS has deterministic NAT egress and no inbound public IP, and all globally unique names will be availability-checked before deployment.
